setup.injection_corpus: Sanskrit, Harvard-Kyoto transliteration (pure ASCII, every character already in the Shakespeare vocab)
setup.ordering: eval_loss[k] and grad_norm[k] are both measured at theta_k, before the optimizer step that produces theta_{k+1}
setup.caveat: a lag of 1 is causal by construction and is not evidence; only lags >= 2 show the norm moving while the loss still looks fine

lag_accounting.note: both are reported because quoting only the first would flatter the result: the window is four steps wide, so the distance from the last bad batch is the smaller number
